dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: So, the wires go here, then there, then here, and then... Ta-da, all done! See, super easy-peasy, right?

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: (Why on earth am I here at this class? Where's Flins? We agreed to come together!)

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Uh... Right! I understand! I've got it written down! All of it!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Writing it down won't do any good. Last time you said you had it memorized, but today you showed up and forgot everything again. Ineffa, confiscate his notebook. You're writing it down from memory now.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: What!? Wait, let me take one more look!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Oh? We're just in time for an exam, it seems.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: You have taken multiple looks, but every look is directed somewhere different. I presume that you are attempting to find methods to evade the lesson.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Such efforts are futile. All such methods have been rendered ineffective.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: But I haven't even said anything!

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Your eyes indicate your intent clearly, Mr. Illuga.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: For instance, you placed the partially finished krumkake in our workshop stove ahead of time.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: I hypothesize that your plan was to secretly take it out during the practical class to draw Aino's attention.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: However, I have already removed that krumkake. It can be reheated for consumption after class.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Lightkeepers sure are a nimble lot...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: How on earth did you find out...

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Mr. Flins has already executed this method once.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: (What!? Flins told me he hid his krumkake in the cabinet! How come he hid it in the stove too!?)

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Also, you were carrying a bag of crushed small fish, Mr. Illuga. I believe that was an attempt to lure stray cats along the roadside as you walked.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: You would put the bag under your feet. The kittens would gather around you. Afterwards, you would pick one up and exclaim, "What a cute kitten"...

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Upon which Aino's attention would be drawn accordingly.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Unfortunately, Mr. Flins has also tried this method before.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: (Impossible! All small animals are afraid of Flins, they wouldn't dare to get close to him. How in the world...)

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: While he did not lure the small animals here himself, he taught this method to Aino.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Subsequently, Aino utilized this method to play with the small animals for an entire afternoon. The lesson for that day had to be canceled.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: This time, however, I have already fed all the small animals present in the area. Therefore, this method will also be ineffective.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: What do you mean you fed all the animals around here? Even the deer and birds...?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Affirmative. In order to preserve the learning environment, I have already fed all the small animals located within the vicinity. Every individual has been attended to.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: As such, please start writing down the circuit diagram we just covered.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Ah, Mr. Illuga. I apologize for intruding upon your studies...

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: #Greetings to you all. Miss Aino, Miss Ineffa, {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} {NICKNAME}, Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: He's here! The truant is here!

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: It is with great regret that I find myself unable to attend your enlightening lectures. However, a matter of absolute urgency necessitates both my own departure and Mr. Illuga's temporary withdrawal from this gathering.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Hmm. The same non-negotiable reason has again been invoked: "A matter of absolute urgency, by order of Headquarters."

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Such is life, full of non-negotiable frustrations.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, your "frustrations" sure do come at the most "inconvenient" times...

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Indeed, that is why we term them so — for they have a "frustrating" habit of arriving at the most inopportune of moments, catching us quite off guard.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Now, Young Master, let us be on our way.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: ...Mr. Flins, none of those tricks you mentioned earlier worked!

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: I'm very sorry to hear that. Hmm... I'll make sure to share some new ones with you next time.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Just a pity that after what just happened, another one of my best ones is now off the table for the foreseeable future...
